jobs.description:
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Experienced order picker?

• Gym membership included at Kuehne + Nagel!
• Hand scanner? Check.
• Quality control & packing? Your thing.
• Electric pallet truck? No problem.
• Sorting, stock counting, handling returns? Routine!
Responsibilities:

• Correctly receiving, labeling, and shipping goods
• Picking goods based on orders
• Operating an electric pallet truck
• Entering required data into the system
• Checking the quality of goods
• Handling returned goods correctly
• Stock counting
• Keeping safety in mind on the shop floor

Do you see yourself getting started? Read on!

Ready to hit the ground running as an order picker at Kuehne + Nagel? Questions? Ask away! Send an email quickly to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15.

VG599/BUOSAP

Qualifications
 
 

• Experienced and fluent in Dutch or English? Check. 

• You start in the day shift (8 AM to 4 PM), and in time work in a 2-shift rotation (6 AM - 2 PM & 2 PM - 10 PM)? No problem for you. 

• Regular weekends? That's your flexible asset. 

• Own transport? Yes. 

• Warehouse experience? You got it!  

 
 
 

• Receiving products and do a quality check  

• Orderpicking 

• Scanning 

• Packing

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

Jimber is looking for an experienced inside sales professional who can open new accounts, qualify commercial potential and develop prospects into concrete sales opportunities. You will work closely with marketing and our account executives while taking clear ownership of your own pipeline.
 

Your responsibilities

- Build and manage outbound activity for selected accounts and sectors.

- Identify and approach relevant decision-makers by phone, LinkedIn, email and at events.

- Start credible commercial conversations with IT managers, security leaders and IT partners.

- Understand the prospect's context, priorities and business challenges.

- Qualify commercial potential, urgency, stakeholders and next steps.

- Develop early-stage prospects into well-prepared sales opportunities.

- Follow up marketing campaigns, event contacts and partner leads.

- Maintain your pipeline and activities accurately in HubSpot.

- Work with marketing and account executives to improve messaging and conversion.
 

Primary focus

- Owning outbound activity across a defined target market.

- Building relationships and qualifying commercial potential.

- Creating a reliable flow of well-developed opportunities.

- At least two years of experience in B2B inside sales or business development.

- Experience in IT, SaaS, cybersecurity or a similar B2B environment.

- A proven ability to open doors and build opportunities through outbound activity.

- Confident engaging decision-makers by phone and in writing.

- Able to explain value clearly without relying on technical jargon.

- Commercially mature, structured and comfortable taking ownership of targets.

- Fluent in Dutch and English. French is an advantage.

Jimber is looking for an experienced sales professional to develop new customers and partners in Belgium and the Netherlands. You will manage the full commercial process for our European SASE platform, from initial contact to signed contract.
 

Your responsibilities

- Identify and approach potential customers and commercial partners.

- Develop new business across Belgium and the Netherlands.

- Engage with IT managers, CISOs, executives and IT partners.

- Analyse security and networking requirements.

- Prepare demonstrations and commercial proposals with our technical team.

- Manage negotiations, procurement processes and contracts.

- Build relationships with integrators, MSPs and MSSPs.

- Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in HubSpot.

- Share market information and customer feedback with product and management.
 

Commercial scope

- Benelux new business development.

- Direct customers and partner-led opportunities.

- Full-cycle ownership with technical support from the Jimber team.

- At least five years of B2B sales experience in cybersecurity, networking, cloud or IT infrastructure.

- A proven track record of building and closing complex sales opportunities.

- Experience with IT integrators, MSPs, MSSPs or security vendors.

- A solid understanding of SASE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, SD-WAN and network security.

- Able to engage credibly with technical and business stakeholders.

- Fluent in Dutch and English. French is an advantage.

Jimber is a Belgian cybersecurity company with its own software platform and ambitious growth plans. We are looking for a marketer who helps determine our market strategy, sharpens our story and turns it into visibility, interest and qualified sales opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities

- Shape positioning, priority markets and go-to-market plans with management.

- Build campaigns that generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.

- Translate technical topics into clear content for customers and partners.

- Manage our website, LinkedIn, email marketing, SEO and events.

- Develop customer stories, product launches and partner campaigns.

- Equip sales with presentations, cases and commercial content.

- Track performance in HubSpot and improve campaigns based on data.

- Coordinate external creatives and specialists when needed.
 

AI-enabled execution

- Use AI for market, competitor and customer research.

- Create and repurpose content with strong quality control.

- Build AI-assisted workflows for campaigns, lead generation and reporting.

- Automate repetitive work and scale what proves effective.

- At least four years of experience in B2B marketing.

- Experience in SaaS, IT or cybersecurity.

- Strong strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Excellent writing skills in English and Dutch.

- Practical experience with generative AI and marketing automation.

- Comfortable with CRM, analytics and longer B2B sales cycles.

jobs.description:
You independently manage your partie from mise-en-place through to service. You contribute ideas and help develop new dishes. Guaranteeing quality, flavour and presentation at the highest level is not an effort for you – it is your standard. For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system:
 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Job introduction

When was the last time you translated a business need into a technical solution that could change an entire organization? That’s exactly what you’ll do with us!

As a Senior SAP Development Lead at delaware, you truly understand what businesses need and how we can deliver it. You’re eager to take the lead in transforming ideas into innovative solutions, guide customers through their move to SAP S/4 HANA, and add value to their business processes.

If development is in your DNA and you’re ready to take on a leading role, then you may be the Senior SAP Development Lead we’re looking for.

Who are we?

Did you know delaware is Belgium’s biggest SAP integrator? This means we get to work with the latest SAP technologies, such as all S/4 HANA deployments, SAP Fiori, SAP Cloud Platform services like ABAP Environment, iRPA, HANA Cloud, API Management, and the SAP Business Technology Platform. Enough with the name-dropping though — you probably already know your way around these technologies! And if you don’t, we’ll happily guide you through them .

We are the SAP Development team. We’re a fun-loving and ambitious team with a strong group dynamic. Even though there are more than 60 of us, we’re still a very tight-knit bunch! We love going for drinks together and we organize the best team events. It’s in our nature to coach our teammates: seniors happily share knowledge with newer members of the team (and vice versa). So what’s it like to work with us? ‘Unique,’ ‘adventurous,’ and ‘challenging’ are just three of the words team members have used to describe their experience. Read our stories here.

We have a broad spectrum of projects and customers in a wide variety of sectors and across the entire range of SAP modules. We also offshore development work to our colleagues in Harbin (China), but it’s up to the development lead to decide which tasks stay with us and which are sent to China.

Just so you know: delaware has offices in Antwerp, Ghent, Kortrijk, Lummen, Liège, and Wavre, but we also spend a lot of time working with our customers on-site. We also offer the flexibility to work from home.

Is there a match?

 

• As a Senior Development Lead, we expect you to have more than 3 years of experience in SAP development. You know your way around the ABAP Platform, Adobe Forms, oData services, Fiori configuration, Eclipse ADT, and more; and how they can add value to business processes. Any supplementary knowledge is a plus.
• You have a strong desire and the capacity to turn business requirements into technical solutions.
• Leadership is your strong suit. Your hands-on, no-nonsense approach means you can provide clear guidance to development teams, both in Belgium and abroad.
• You are cut from the right consulting cloth: you’re proactive and a good communicator who combines the drive for results with flexibility and an understanding of the coordination of development trajectories, both in and outside SAP.
• Dutch  is either your native language or you’ve become fluent over your professional career. You can communicate clearly in English.

Who we are looking for
 

We are looking for a Senior Data Protection Advisor to integrate our Privacy & Data Governance BU.

The current business dynamics are unprecedented for this department, which is multiplying ambitious projects all over Belgium. In other words, Approach is a major player in Data Protection and Data Governance and is quickly evolving.

 

We are therefore actively looking for people who have the ambition to participate in the development of the data protection department at Approach, while advising clients from various sizes and sectors, helping them improve their privacy and risk management maturity, providing top-notch legal expertise as well as governance recommendations.
 

You will have the opportunity to grow your expertise by getting acquainted and/or certified in recognized INDUSTRY and privacy STANDARDS (ISO 27001, ISO 31700, Europrivacy certifications, etc.) with our experts, and advise clients on the latest legislative frameworks.

 

Your role and responsibilities

 

You will join a small team with all levels of seniority. You will integrate your field of action within a more global cybersecurity approach. Therefore, you could rely on the knowledge of your expert colleagues with both technical and legal backgrounds.

 

You could:

• Provide high value services to customers in the light of Approach’s data protection offering/business:
• Bring your knowledge and energy on different steps of data protection projects, autonomously or within the team.
• Advise on all aspects of data privacy.
• Participate in the development of Data Privacy Impact Assessments (DPIA) and supervise their implementation.
• Monitor compliance with the international and local data protection legislations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, e-privacy directive, Data Governance Act, …)
• Drive privacy compliance audits.
• Train employees involved in data processing activities.
• Liaise with national Supervisory Authorities (SA’s)

Use your energy, your proactivity, and your smile to develop our Privacy & Data Protection business unit by (for example):

• Actively contributing to the development of tools and methodologies used by your team.
• Sharing your knowledge about sector news to your team.
• Contributing to develop a business/commercial approach towards potential customers.
• 
Following and coaching junior colleagues on your specific expertise.

 

Your profile

You have :

• Recognized Data Privacy Officer certification OR any other training, certifications, Executive Master, … in the frame of data protection or cybersecurity.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar function (DPO, Assistant DPO, Privacy officer, legal counsel, …)
• Good understanding of Information Risk Management and methodologies
• Interest in Data Protection technologies and how they link to Data Privacy
• English and Dutch is a must have. Bilingual (FR/NL) is a plus.
• True communicator with Business level communication skills: to make complex legal or data protection concepts easy to understand by a business or a technical audience, and to interact with C-level, to work with legal, GRC and IT departments, to challenge technical implementations and to understand business needs.

Considered as a plus:

 

• Ability to understand senior management considerations (strategic level) and ability to help them in their decision.
• Good understanding of ISO27000 standards
• Experience in risk assessments as assessor or contributor
• Exposure to security audit, as auditor, auditee, remediation owner
• Exposure to (security) incident response and crisis management

Mindset:

 

• Willingness to provide high quality deliverables and to go the extra mile.
• Project oriented by being dedicated to the client’s objectives and give advice.
• Teamplayer
• Manage diverse workloads and prioritize accordingly.
• Ambassador for the professional values that are at the heart of our philosophy:
TOP-NOTCH: We strive for best-of-the-best while staying up to date with the latest technology.

HUMAN-CENTRIC: We care about people in the digital world, listening before interacting respectfully in a responsible environment.

NO-NONSENSE: We go for it, we work together, we are committed to deliver, to exceed expectations.
